notes.title: Demo 1.01 Update
notes.content:
1.	Fixed a rare freeze issue when playback ended midway during a reverse.
	2.	Fixed some controller image display issues.
	3.	Added new controller button mappings: you can now use shoulder buttons to rotate clockwise or counterclockwise, as well as the left/right buttons from the right-hand face buttons for rotation.
